address: 22 MacLean Street, Paraparaumu Beach, Kapiti Coast, 5032, New Zealand
bio: This tiny gem on the Kapiti Coast is the brainchild of owner-chef Helen Turnbull. She was formally trained in Tokyo, Japan, before stints in some world-famous kitchens in the UK and France. Here at 50-50, she champions a modern take on New Zealand cuisine, showing utmost respect for seasonality and using quality produce from local producers. Her six- or nine-course tasting menu accentuates natural flavours while incorporating subtle global influences.
